title: Final practical assessment: requirements, variant and criteria first
goal: Prepare an independent applied project with known criteria while retaining earlier results.
prerequisites: 1c-enterprise.a 7; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.
outcomes: Different identities are not grouped by name alone.
sections: Start the final work from operator tasks: create a request, find open work, obtain a total and restore a copy. Screen lists do not replace requirements. Specify input, action, expectation and evidence for each scenario. Variant parameters are separate so the work is not merely replaying a solved example.

Open this direction in Nexus and choose Open final assessment from its curriculum. There are three theory variants, four practical tasks and one of three projects. Read your variant and criteria first. Reading 32 topics does not replace the project; completion from the other direction does not transfer.

Positive cases show usefulness; negative cases show boundaries. Include empty customer, invalid duration and attempted restore over existing work. Verify both rejection and unchanged state. A successful ordinary input after failure proves usability rather than mere action blocking.

Use 12 durations:30, 45, 15, 0, 60, 20, 25, 35, 40, 50, 55, 65, totaling 440. Assign odd positions to one customer and even positions to another:225/215. A third equal-named customer with a different reference and no requests tests identity. All records are synthetic.

Prepare 12 synthetic requests across customers, statuses and duration boundaries. Calculate control totals manually before running reports. A teaching template may seed a new copy, but record provenance and your own changes. Never overwrite previously accepted work for a final variant.

Separate the required core from your extension. Core: cards, references, write/search, customer filtering, correct units and recovery. An optional description or custom form is a separately copied extension with its own checks. Do not claim an absent period filter exists.

Assess data correctness separately from usability and explanation. Source preservation during restore is critical: a beautiful report cannot compensate for destroyed work. Local candidate assessment is self-report; instructor review is separate. An A result transfers no P credit and does not certify professional development.

Create a separate result folder and infobase/copy with provenance before input. Calculate controls without using the report being tested. Build requirement → action → expected set → observation → status. Attractive presentation cannot compensate for lost work.
